cwsListing.shortDescription: A premium, fully offline-capable Telugu Calendar (Panchangam), Daily Horoscope (రాశి ఫలాలు), and Vedic Sankalpam for your New Tab
cwsListing.detailedDescription: A premium, fully offline-capable Telugu Calendar (Panchangam), Daily Horoscope (రాశి ఫలాలు), and Vedic Sankalpam for your New Tab page.
cwsListing.singlePurpose: Replaces the new tab page with a Telugu calendar (Panchangam) showing daily tithi, nakshatra, festivals, horoscope (Rasi Phalalu) and Sankalpam for the user's location.
cwsListing.remoteCodeJustification: The extension does not use remote code. All JavaScript (including the vendored lib/astronomy.js) is packaged in the extension; there is no eval(), new Function() or remotely hosted script. It only loads Google Fonts stylesheets and fetches JSON weather data from Open-Meteo, neither of which is executed.

permissionJustifications.storage: Stores the user's settings (language/display preferences), saved location coordinates and personal reminders (solar-date and lunar-tithi reminders) locally in chrome.storage.local so they persist across new tabs.
permissionJustifications.geolocation: Used, with the user's permission, to get the user's approximate coordinates once so sunrise/sunset, tithi/nakshatra timings, Rahu Kalam and the Sankalpam text are computed for their location, and to show local weather (coordinates are sent to the Open-Meteo weather API). The user can instead enter a location manually; coordinates are stored only locally.
